title: Police reject request to suspend Taser use
article: In the wake of Quebec's second Taser-related death in less than a month, law-enforcement authorities have rejected a request for a temporary ban on the device.
Quilem Registre of Montreal died early yesterday at a Montreal hospital, after he'd been Tasered by Montreal police Sunday night.
"The Taser continues to be a safe and effective use of force for police services in Canada," said Steve Palmer, executive director of the Canadian Police Research Centre in Ottawa.

Claudio Castagnetta, 32, died in Quebec City Sept. 20 after police there used a Taser on him Sept. 18. Robert Dziekanski, 40, of Pieszyce, Poland, died over the weekend after being Tasered at Vancouver's airport.
